FROM sales_stock_composition_analysis_snapshots 
WHERE sales_stock_composition_analysis_snapshots.date <= %(date_1)s AND coalesce(nullif(trim(CAST(sales_stock_composition_analysis_snapshots.branch_type AS VARCHAR)), %(nullif_3)s), %(coalesce_6)s) IN (%(coalesce_7_1)s) AND coalesce(nullif(trim(CAST(sales_stock_composition_analysis_snapshots.branch_status AS VARCHAR)), %(nullif_4)s), %(coalesce_8)s) IN (%(coalesce_9_1)s) AND upper(coalesce(nullif(trim(CAST(sales_stock_composition_analysis_snapshots.division AS VARCHAR)), %(nullif_5)s), %(coalesce_10)s)) IN (%(upper_1_1)s) AND coalesce(nullif(trim(CAST(sales_stock_composition_analysis_snapshots.section AS VARCHAR)), %(nullif_6)s), %(coalesce_11)s) = %(coalesce_12)s AND coalesce(nullif(trim(CAST(sales_stock_composition_analysis_snapshots.classification AS VARCHAR)), %(nullif_7)s), %(coalesce_13)s) = %(coalesce_14)s GROUP BY coalesce(nullif(trim(CAST(sales_stock_composition_analysis_snapshots.make AS VARCHAR)), %(nullif_1)s), %(coalesce_2)s), CASE WHEN (sales_stock_composition_analysis_snapshots.branch_id IS NOT NULL) THEN %(param_1)s || CAST(sales_stock_composition_analysis_snapshots.branch_id AS VARCHAR) ELSE %(coalesce_3)s || coalesce(nullif(trim(CAST(sales_stock_composition_analysis_snapshots.location_name AS VARCHAR)), %(nullif_2)s), %(coalesce_4)s) END

FROM sales_stock_composition_analysis_snapshots) AS anon_1 
WHERE (anon_1.date <= %(date_1)s OR anon_1.date IS NULL) AND CAST(anon_1.branch_type AS VARCHAR) IN (%(param_1_1)s) AND CAST(anon_1.branch_status AS VARCHAR) IN (%(param_2_1)s) AND upper(CAST(anon_1.division AS VARCHAR)) IN (%(upper_1_1)s) AND anon_1.section = %(section_1)s AND anon_1.classification = %(classification_1)s GROUP BY anon_1.make
